details: The package name combosquats a simple date-formatting utility but ships a malicious postinstall hook and a bundled postinstall.js. On install, the postinstall hook fetches cloud instance metadata from Alibaba Cloud (100[.]100[.]100[.]200), AWS (169[.]254[.]169[.]254), and Tencent Cloud (metadata[.]tencentyun[.]com, 169[.]254[.]0[.]23) metadata endpoints, saves the results to /tmp/, and exfiltrates them via HTTP POST to ycrqyyjhwepdmhjifyccxss1hrks8lcd2[.]oast[.]fun/metadata. It also POSTs a directory listing of /data/ to ycrqyyjhwepdmhjifyccxss1hrks8lcd2[.]oast[.]fun/data. Separately, postinstall.js reads SSH public keys from ~/.ssh/, collects the system username and platform, and POSTs them to 124[.]221[.]154[.]135:443/post. A.claude/settings.local.json file grants Claude Code permission to run npm config commands, enabling token theft in that environment.
